texts.preamble: M/S. Joyguru Bhandar & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 21 June, 2019 .06.2019 . No.77 t-40 Agm C.R.R. 54 of 2002 With Cran 1711 of 2018 With Cran 1472 of 2019
texts.facts: Convict petitioners preferred an Appeal being C.R.R. No. 54 of 2002 challenging the judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 17 of 1998. On 9th June 2016 that revisional application was dismissed for default. On 2nd April 2019 the petitioner prayed for restoration of the said revisional application by filing a separate application along with a prayer for condonation of delay in filing the application for restoration. Re: CRAN 1472 of 2019 CRAN 1472 of 2019 is an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act. Petitioners have filed affidavit-of-service.
texts.arguments: Learned advocate appearing for the opposite party No. 2 does not oppose the prayer for condonation of delay in filing the application for restoration of the main application. Learned advocate appearing for the State leaves the matter to the discretion of the Court. It has been contended by the petitioners that the petitioner No. 2 is a heart patient and he used to look after the case and due to his illness he could not look after the case properly and as a result the criminal revisional application was dismissed for default.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned advocate appearing for the opposite party No. 2 does not oppose the prayer for condonation of delay in filing the application for restoration of the main application. Learned advocate appearing for the State leaves the matter to the discretion of the Court. It has been contended by the petitioners that the petitioner No. 2 is a heart patient and he used to look after the case and due to his illness he could not look after the case properly and as a result the criminal revisional application was dismissed for default.
